name: AMENITY
author: Presethead
tagline: A live jungle firmware for the FM-1
description: Amenity turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a live jungle break machine. Three classic breaks are built in and you can add four of your own from a web page; a 16-step sequencer slices, rolls, stretches and flips them, with fills, filter sweeps and instant effects on the black keys. The keys play the slices, the knobs shape feedback, variation, warp and the filter, and it follows or sends MIDI clock over USB and Bluetooth.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
